prompt.en: Where in Canada are there municipal police departments?
prompt.fr: Où trouve-t-on des services de police municipaux au Canada?

options.fr: Seulement en Ontario et au Québec.

options.en: Only in cities of more than one million people.
options.fr: Seulement dans les villes de plus d'un million d'habitants.

explanation.en: Every province has municipal police departments, alongside the other kinds of police force.
explanation.fr: Chaque province a des services de police municipaux, en plus des autres types de corps policiers.

source.quote: There are provincial police forces in Ontario and Quebec and municipal police departments in all provinces.

verification.evidence: provincial police forces in Ontario and Quebec and municipal police departments in all provinces
